# Oktavianus Balu Say — Photography Portfolio

> Portfolio website of Oktavianus Balu Say, a photographer working in event, wedding, prewedding, brand and product, and portrait photography.

## Work
- [Events](https://abdizakiy.github.io/ovis-say/#events): concerts, stages and the details around them
- [Brand & Product](https://abdizakiy.github.io/ovis-say/#commercial): studio and product photography for brands
- [Prewedding](https://abdizakiy.github.io/ovis-say/#prewedding): prewedding sessions for couples
- [Wedding](https://abdizakiy.github.io/ovis-say/#wedding): wedding day photography
- [Selected frames](https://abdizakiy.github.io/ovis-say/#frames): ten further photographs from different sessions

## How a shoot works
- [Process](https://abdizakiy.github.io/ovis-say/#process): inquiry and consultation, planning and scheduling, photoshoot day, editing and post-production, image delivery, follow-up and feedback
